summary: Owner checks protect private profiles, users and portfolios; leaderboard remains publicly readable and owner-writable. 15 local emulator assertions pass.

findings.issue: Portfolio and leaderboard balances are still calculated by the client. A modified client can falsify its own score.
findings.recommendation: Move trade execution and leaderboard updates to authenticated server transactions.

findings.issue: Legacy owner-only portfolio subcollections retain flexible payloads without detailed schema limits.
findings.recommendation: Introduce per-document schemas alongside a versioned portfolio model.
